zh: 卡钳，测径器，两脚规，卡尺（用于测量管子、圆形物体的直径）
双脚规形夹（支撑无力或受伤的腿的金属支架）
en: an instrument with two long thin parts joined at one end, used for measuring the diameter of tubes and round objects (= the distance across them)
ex: a pair of calipers
一把卡尺

zh: 哈里发（尤为旧时穆斯林领袖的称号）
en: a title used by Muslim rulers, especially in the past
the position of a caliph
physical exercises intended to develop a strong and attractive body
to give somebody/something a particular name; to use a particular name or title when you are talking to somebody
ex: They decided to call the baby Mark.
他们决定给婴儿取名马克。

en: to stop at a place for a short time
ex: This train calls at Didcot and Reading.
这趟列车在迪德科特和雷丁停车。

en: to ask somebody to stop what they are doing and to go somewhere else
ex: She was called away from the meeting to take an urgent phone call.
她被叫出会场去接一个紧急电话。

en: to phone somebody again or to phone somebody who phoned you earlier
ex: She said she'd call back.
她说她会再打电话来。

en: a small unit with walls and a roof, containing a public phone, in the street, etc.

zh: 电话服务中心（安排保险、接受订单、解答问题等）
en: an office in which a large number of people work using phones, for example arranging insurance for people, or taking customers’ orders and answering questions
ex: to work in a call centre
在呼叫中心工作

en: to collect somebody in order to go somewhere
ex: I'll call for you at 7 o'clock.
我 7 点钟来接你。

en: to produce a particular reaction
ex: His speech called forth an angry response.
他的发言引起了一阵愤怒。

en: a prostitute who makes her arrangements by phone
to phone a place, especially the place where you work
ex: Several people have called in sick today.
今天有几个人打电话请病假。

zh: （电台、电视台的）代号字母，呼号
en: the letters that are used to identify a radio or television station
ex: the call letters WNBC
台号字母 WNBC

zh: 把（人）叫走（不再搜查等）；把（狗）叫开（不让它咬人等）
en: to order a dog or a person to stop attacking, searching, etc.
ex: to call off a deal/trip/strike
取消交易／旅行／罢工
